obligation: NERC CIP-008-6 R4 Reportable Cyber Security Incident notification
deadline: (High/medium impact BES Cyber Systems and associated EACMS) Within 1 hour after determination of a Reportable Cyber Security Incident; by end of next calendar day for an attempt to compromise an applicable system; updates within 7 calendar days of new information

obligation: DOE Form OE-417 Electric Emergency Incident and Disturbance Report (includes cyber events)
citation: Form OE-417 (mandatory under Federal Energy Administration Act of 1974, 15 U.S.C. 772(b))
deadline: 1 hour or 6 hours depending on event type (per DOE); final report within 72 hours
notify: DOE Office of Cybersecurity, Energy Security, and Emergency Response (CESER)

deadline: As soon as practicable, but no later than 72 hours after identifying a cybersecurity incident (IC Surface-2025-01 recommends earlier notice to TSA for significant incidents)
notify: CISA Central (cisa.gov/report or 844-729-2472); CISA shares with TSA

deadline: 1 hour / 4 hours / 8 hours depending on event; 24-hour recordable events
notify: NRC Headquarters Operations Center via ENS

obligation: CIRCIA covered cyber incident report / ransom payment report (PROPOSED - not yet in effect)
deadline: 72 hours after reasonable belief a covered cyber incident occurred; 24 hours after ransom payment disbursed (proposed)
